title: uuencoding-multi: SubjectParts should be defined in subject.rs, not lib.rs
description: SubjectParts is defined in lib.rs but only ever constructed in subject.rs. Every other struct/producer pair (TocEntry/ParsedToc, PartEntry/PartCollection, ReassembledFile) is colocated. The inconsistency requires looking in two files to understand SubjectParts. Move SubjectParts to subject.rs and re-export from lib.rs.
